example_message_synthetic: Dear customer, your bank account will be blocked today. Update KYC now: hxxp://kyc-update.example/login
red_flags: Urgency and threat; link not from the bank; asks for login details
advised_action: Do not click. Check only in the bank's official app or branch. If money is lost, call 1930 at once.

scam_type: Caller posing as bank or official asking for OTP or PIN
example_message_synthetic: Caller: I am from your bank. Share the OTP sent to your phone to stop a wrong transaction.
red_flags: Asks for OTP or PIN; creates panic; unsolicited call
advised_action: Hang up. Never share an OTP or PIN. Call the bank using the number on the card or official site.

example_message_synthetic: Congratulations! You won Rs 25 lakh. Pay Rs 5,000 processing fee to claim.
red_flags: Prize you never entered; asks money first
advised_action: Ignore and block. Real prizes do not need a fee.

example_message_synthetic: Earn Rs 5,000 daily by liking videos. Join our group and deposit Rs 1,000 to start.
red_flags: Unrealistic pay; deposit required; moves chat to messaging group
advised_action: Do not deposit money. Report the number and group.

example_message_synthetic: Your power will be cut tonight at 9:30 pm unless you call XXXXXXXXXX and pay the pending bill.
red_flags: Deadline pressure; personal mobile number; no bill details
advised_action: Check the bill in the electricity company's official app or office. Do not call the number.

example_message_synthetic: Your refund is pending. Approve the request in your UPI app to receive the money.
red_flags: Receiving money never needs approval or a PIN
advised_action: Decline the request. Never enter a PIN to receive money.

example_message_synthetic: Your OTP for the transaction is 123456. Do not share it with anyone.
red_flags: Sent after you started a transaction; contains no link or request
advised_action: Use it only in your own transaction and never share it.
